decisions.what: Implementation runs on branch `pipeline` in the main checkout, not a linked worktree.
decisions.why: The build depends on live per-checkout state a worktree cannot share: x-agent/mcp/node_modules + dist, tools/node_modules, and tools/.runtime Playground descriptors. Tree was clean at branch time; isolation is by branch.

decisions.what: pipeline/ is plain ESM .mjs importing x-agent/mcp/dist directly (no TypeScript, no build step, no new npm deps); unit tests run on node:test; JSON-Schema checks use a minimal in-repo draft-07 subset validator.
decisions.why: The spec's environment says the pipeline imports dist; proof/ set the deps-free precedent; the house rule is no ajv (x-agent/tests/schemas.test.ts) and zod is not resolvable from repo root without a new node_modules.
